mapper.select:
SELECT H.ID AS HOSPITAL_ID, H.BIZ_ID, H.NAME, H.PHONE, H.ZIPCODE, H.ADDR1, H.ADDR2, H.LAT, H.LNG, H.DESCRIPTION, H.TAGS, H.TIMETABLE, (SELECT F.URL FROM FILES F WHERE F.REF_TYPE = 'HOSPITAL' AND F.REF_ID = H.ID AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS THUMB FROM HOSPITAL H WHERE 1=1
AND (H.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR H.ADDR1 LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR H.ADDR2 LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND H.TAGS LIKE '%' || #{tagFilter} || '%'
AND H.TAGS LIKE '%' || #{target} || '%'
ORDER BY H.ID DESC

SELECT H.ID AS HOSPITAL_ID, H.BIZ_ID, H.NAME, H.PHONE, H.ZIPCODE, H.ADDR1, H.ADDR2, H.LAT, H.LNG, H.DESCRIPTION, H.TAGS, H.TIMETABLE, (SELECT F.URL FROM FILES F WHERE F.REF_TYPE = 'HOSPITAL' AND F.REF_ID = H.ID AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS THUMB FROM HOSPITAL H WHERE ID = #{hospitalId}

SELECT H.ID AS HOSPITAL_ID, H.BIZ_ID, H.NAME, H.PHONE, H.ZIPCODE, H.ADDR1, H.ADDR2, H.LAT, H.LNG, H.DESCRIPTION, H.TAGS, H.TIMETABLE, (SELECT F.URL FROM FILES F WHERE F.REF_TYPE = 'HOSPITAL' AND F.REF_ID = H.ID AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS THUMB FROM HOSPITAL H JOIN BUSINESS B ON H.BIZ_ID = B.ID WHERE B.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT H.ID AS HOSPITAL_ID, H.BIZ_ID, H.NAME, H.PHONE, H.ZIPCODE, H.ADDR1, H.ADDR2, H.LAT, H.LNG, H.DESCRIPTION, H.TAGS, H.TIMETABLE, (SELECT F.URL FROM FILES F WHERE F.REF_TYPE = 'HOSPITAL' AND F.REF_ID = H.ID AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS THUMB FROM HOSPITAL H WHERE BIZ_ID = #{bizId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HOSPITAL ( BIZ_ID, NAME, PHONE, ZIPCODE, ADDR1, ADDR2, CREATED ) SELECT B.ID, B.NAME, B.PHONE, B.ZIPCODE, B.ADDR1, B.ADDR2, SYSDATE FROM BUSINESS B WHERE B.ID = #{bizId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM HOSPITAL H WHERE H.BIZ_ID = B.ID )
